limits: Profiler activity estimates concern this evolved capture window; they are not unprofiled timings, full-run partitions or speedup evidence.
Ownership follows the unique CUDA runtime launch correlation and full application NVTX ancestry; asynchronous GPU start times do not determine host-scope ownership.
Phase ownership is disjoint by event. Union sums can overlap across phases/streams; the explicit difference quantifies overlap.
Host NVTX times are inclusive, nested and asynchronous; they are never added to GPU activity time.
Recorded API/device correlations and scope counts cannot rule out records absent from both inventories or prove acquisition losslessness.
The capture intentionally terminates a fresh trajectory and cannot replace full physical-result qualification.
Initial global setup and final output are outside the selected evolved-window stages.
Unmatched full-trace activity is retained as a coverage count and cannot be assigned to selected RK steps.
Current A + residual and P + solution update are combined work groups; no pure A/P speedup can be inferred.
Baseline/current captures begin after the same 180-second wall delay but can cover different physical states and different GPUs.
Cross-window ratios are descriptive recorded-activity ratios, not unprofiled application speedups.
Complete-RK selection, launch reciprocity and matching work counts do not establish lossless acquisition; retained profiler warnings require review.

historical_GPU_comparison.interpretation: Grouped descriptive comparison against frozen stage-fused NSys3443736, including its standalone subtract/Add costs. Different evolved states/GPU scheduling and profiler warnings preclude an application speedup claim.

recorded_GPU_window.historical_reference_note: Historical GPU reference is a separate capture, not a GPU measurement of this full pair's baseline arm.

interpretation: The six host bins partition measured application wall time; GPU tables are separate descriptive profile-window measurements.
RunEulerCase begins before its communicator queries and ends before its timing line and local destruction; the external residual includes work on both sides of that scope.
Host phases include their existing staging and waits. Asynchronous GPU work may cross these phase boundaries; no synchronization was added for timing.
Diagnostics covers configured on_visualize (alive/GLVis) and on_analysis hooks. Other existing loop checks remain in the advancing complement.
Existing IGR production host totals include initialization and prefetched output work, so they are not subtracted to infer exclusive Euler time.
GPU percentages use recorded activity unions. Group union sums can overlap across streams; their difference from the all-activity union is reported, never normalized away.
Euler kernel subgroup percentages use recorded kernel-duration sums, excluding copies; these are distinct from activity-union percentages.
Current A plus residual and P plus solution update are combined work groups; fused pure A/P and residual/update times cannot be separated.
Per-RK GPU numbers normalize only by selected complete RK steps. No GPU window is multiplied by full-run stage counts or added to host wall time.
A single sequential same-GPU unprofiled pair is a measured comparison; it does not establish repeatability or isolate clock and run-order effects.

interpretation_limits: NCU intentionally ends the diagnostic application after six matching launches; physical completion is not claimed.
The application evolves continuously from the ordinary initial condition to RK/Step1200; no restart or state replay.
Only the first two currentA applications in the selected RK step are sampled; they are not an average over stages or the trajectory.
Kernel replay with all-cache flush changes cache state; profiler durations do not measure full-case performance.
Local-memory traffic and instructions do not alone establish compiler spill counts.
Unsupported or missing counters are null, never a measured zero.
Output cadence .1 is diagnostic only; matched application timings retain their original .02 cadence.
